rv.q: The wit, speed of thought, comic invention, improvisation, timing and sheer brilliance of all the performers take your breath away.
Tonight's audience was on its feet at the end giving this hard working company a well-deserved standing ovation.

cn.t: Critics praise the show's impressive improvisation skills, with performers creating a polished, fully improvised musical on the spot that's so smooth it's hard to believe nothing was prepared in advance.
